notes.title: Version 1.1, bug fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] camera no longer should clip into machines and plants
[*] player character customization now should load properly
[*] fixed incorrect initial state of labels in video options
[*] fixed missing sound attenuation on some machines
[*] maybe fixed radio sometimes not being interactable
[*] fixed meshes disappearing at certain angles in boat interior
[*] added slider for shadows contrast to video options
[*] fixed hut's black logs glitch
[*] fixed gather mission not completing if conditions are met upon granting it
[*] fix for recipe changing already made product in machine output slot
[*] fixed recon mission marker not showing up on compass
[*] fixed splashes sometimes being active on torpedo boat when docked
[*] ships now magically insta unflip rather than do that via applying force
[*] error message on logistics screen doesn't prevent clicks anymore
[*] changing configuration on ongoing transport shouldn't unassign it anymore
[*] fixed certain ceo being resurrected in certain conditions
[*] trash islands shouldn't have unexpected holes anymore
[*] computer ration parts no longer draw as behind glass
[/list]
